neighborhoods.name: Dawdon
neighborhoods.notes: former colliery village, working-class housing stock

property_mix.era: mixed Victorian mining terraces and post-war suburban development
property_mix.notable: Significant legacy of colliery housing; substantial post-1945 expansion. Coastal location with salt-air corrosion affecting older locks and frames.

locksmith_relevant: Mining-era terraces have original Victorian locks; many require specialist restoration or period-appropriate replacement.
Post-war semi-detached properties predominate; standard modern security upgrades and double-glazed door locks are high-demand services.
Coastal exposure accelerates corrosion of external locks and hinges; preventative maintenance and weatherproof fitting is essential here.
